messages:
maria: FYI I opened a Terraform PR to add a preemptible GPU capacity pool in us-west-2. Want to discuss AMI rotation, interruption handling, and rollout plan.

kevin: link? Also what's the mix of instance types? A100 on spot scares me.

maria: PR: https://git.redwood/infra/pull/483 — mixed pool: a10g, g5, t4 (fallback on g5s). Not using A100 for spot initially.

jia: +1 on no A100. We need a spot interruption webhook and a node-drainer that catches the GCP/AWS termination notice. I can add a small lambda/k8s daemonset.

sam: For TF, prefer separate aws_autoscaling_group per family with its own launch_template to keep AMI and kernel modules simple. MixedInstancesPolicy is tempting but complicates driver installs.

lucy: tagging request: 'pool:preemptible-gpu', 'tier:batch', 'reclaimable:true', 'billing_owner:infra'. This helps cost reports and autoscaler filters.

maria: Good. Also adding a canary: 2 instances in a new ASG, traffic weight 0.1, healthchecks + spike test for throughput. If canary passes, we rollout to 50% then 100%.

kevin: What's allocation strategy? capacity-optimized or lowest-price? capacity-optimized reduces churn but can be slightly costlier.

maria: capacity-optimized for GPUs. We'll set max-price null to allow market price, and a fallback on-demand pool.

jia: Reminder: need to pin AMI lifecycle: bake drivers in AMI and include AMI rotation terraform variable, plus a job to rebuild AMI weekly with latest kernel/drivers.

sam: Can we add a tf plan snippet in PR showing launch_template userdata? e.g.

```hcl
resource "aws_launch_template" "preemptible_gpu_lt" {
  name_prefix = "preempt-gpu-"
  image_id    = var.gpu_ami
  instance_type = var.instance_type
  user_data = base64encode(<<EOF
#!/bin/bash
set -e
# install nvidia driver from baked AMI fallback
/sbin/driver-check || /usr/local/bin/install-drivers.sh
EOF
  )
  tag_specifications = [
    {
      resource_type = "instance"
      tags = {
        "pool" = "preemptible-gpu"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

lucy: Also add cloudwatch logs for interruption handler and a tag for billing to show up in dashboards.

opsbot: deploy-bot: terraform plan completed for branch preemptible-gpu (plan id 8123). No destructive changes.

maria: Next steps: jayne and ops team to review PR, Jia to draft daemonset for termination notice, Sam to split ASGs per family. I'll add canary tf vars. Any other objections?

kevin: none from me. pls ensure k8s node labels for instanceType and gpuType so schedulers can prefer larger jobs on certain nodes.

lucy: I'll update cost dashboards and add alerts on revocation rate > 5% / hr.

maria: Thanks all. I'll merge after approvals and we'll monitor the canary for 24h.
